result.edit: The test fails at cycle=5 with incorrect Gray code output (0110 vs expected 0010). The issue is in the Gray-to-binary conversion where the XOR operations incorrectly depend on intermediate bin_out values rather than directly on gray_wire bits. This causes incorrect binary conversion which propagates to the Gray code output. The fix changes the XOR operations to use only gray_wire bits for conversion, ensuring correct binary values and thus correct Gray code output.
